meta.tagline: See what's on your ballot. In plain English.

landing.heading: Your vote, clearly explained.
landing.subheading: Civic Mirror walks you through every measure on your Los Angeles County ballot in plain English — sorted by what matters to you. Take the 2-minute values quiz and we'll show you which way to vote and why.
landing.step1: Tell us what you care about (12 quick sliders).
landing.step2: We sort the measures on your ballot by alignment with your priorities.
landing.step3: Each one comes with a plain-language summary, source quotes, and who's funding it.
landing.trustNote: Nonpartisan. Every claim links back to the official voter pamphlet.
landing.noElectionData: No published measures yet. Check back soon.

ballot.heading: Your ballot
ballot.subheading: Sorted by how well each measure lines up with the priorities you set in the quiz.
ballot.noPriorities: You haven't taken the quiz yet — measures are listed in default order.
ballot.noContributors: Take the quiz to see why this measure matches you.

measure.sourcesIntro: Every claim above traces back to one of these verbatim quotes from the official voter pamphlet.

quiz.heading: What do you care about?
quiz.instructions: Drag each slider to show how important the topic is to you. We use these weights to sort your ballot — we never share or sell them, and they live in a cookie on this device only.
quiz.savedNote: Your priorities are saved on this device only.

about.heading: How we made this
about.body: Civic Mirror is a nonpartisan voter tool. Every plain-language summary is generated from official voter-pamphlet text and reviewed by a human before it's published. We show you the source quotes for every claim so you can check our work.
